items: 【UPGRADED WIDE SHOULDER STRAPS】 Experience superior comfort on your way to the shore. Unlike common beach bags with thin straps that dig into your skin, our tote is designed with widened shoulder straps. This ergonomic design effectively distributes weight, ensuring a pain-free carry even when the 23L bag is fully packed.

【23L QUANTIFIED LARGE CAPACITY】 Boasting a spacious 23L volume (18x14x7 inches), this oversized mesh tote provides ample room for all your necessities. It easily fits 4 large beach towels, snorkeling gear, and family snacks, making it the ultimate "carry-all" for a full day of sun and surf.

【SANDPROOF REINFORCED BOTTOM】 Keep the sand where it belongs—at the beach. Our bag features a solid, no-hole polyester base. While the breathable diamond mesh body allows for excellent airflow to dry wet towels and gear, the reinforced solid bottom prevents sand from seeping in when you set the bag down on the beach.

【RUGGED ANTI-TEAR CONSTRUCTION】 Crafted from high-density sandwich grid cloth and premium diamond mesh, this bag is built to handle heavy loads. The reinforced stitching and tear-resistant fabric provide a long-lasting solution for carrying up to 30 lbs of beach essentials, gym equipment, or groceries.

【SECURE STORAGE & FOLDABLE】 Stay organized with a secure internal zippered compartment for valuables like phones and keys, plus a quick-access external pocket for sunscreen. This lightweight bag folds completely flat for easy suitcase packing, making it a must-have for cruises and tropical vacations.
